description: Self-correction (0 fit): the magic-A ⁴He +5.87% is the gap of the separate doubly-magic formula B=2·m_e·A·8G (29.956 vs 28.296 MeV), NOT a finite-truncation residual of the body-order geometric series as PR #2718's audit asserted in passing. The physical-body-order (n≤A=4) jet-sum is only 2.49 MeV (≈11× too small) and the series diverges (λ₊>1). Re-scopes the #2718 claim; the spectral-bridge result (λ₊>1 extensive growth) is unaffected.
caveats: Re-scope of PR #2718's audit: the +5.87% is the magic-A-formula residual, a distinct object from the body-order series. The spectral-bridge λ₊>1 extensive-growth result stands; only its tie to the magic-A gap was wrong.
